records.issue_text: The denial cache in pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go is never invalidated or coordinated with permCache, so a user stays denied for the full shortCacheTTL even after the DB grants access and permCache is refreshed, re-introducing the staleness the fallback was meant to avoid and bypassing existing permCache invalidation paths
records.rationale: The diff adds `permDenialCache` and checks it first in `Service.Check` (`if _, ok := s.permDenialCache.Get(...); ok { return Allowed:false }`). This early return bypasses both the cached-permissions path and the DB fallback, so once `permDenialCache` is set (`if !allowed { s.permDenialCache.Set(...) }`), a later DB grant (or refreshed `permCache`) cannot take effect until the denial entry expires.
